The path of the URL where the bundle is going to be hosted. By default it is `./`, making the bundle relocatable. Set an absolute path such as `/sites/my-site/` to host the bundle at a fixed location.

## CLI flag

```text
--public-path <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)
- [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)
- [`remotion bundle`](/docs/cli/bundle)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`bundle()`](/docs/bundle#publicpath)
